notes.title: Recovery Frames
notes.content: - Updated(decreased) recovery frames for all of the main character's moves, making him more agile.

notes.title: More balancing
notes.content:
- removed/moved a couple of enemies.
- on the Bee boss fight (stage3), bullets now spawn at a fixed interval. This way, the player now has the option to collect the bullets and shoot the boss, instead of being limited to the melee attack.

notes.title: Improvements and fixes
notes.content:
- Overall rebalancing
- Fixed/improved position of flying enemies at stage 5 boss battle so that the ones above and below can easily be targeted as well.
